issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

on.description:
List of column names to match. It's required when the mode is MERGE
e.g. df.write_table(table, mode="merge", on=["id", "timestamp"]) will match rows in df and table that have the same id and timestamp

how.description: Define merge actions based on specified conditions. Only applicable when mode is 'merge'. See {@link MergeActions} for more details.

createTableSpec.description:
Specifications for creating a table if missing;
if empty, table is inferred using DataLake.CreateTableSpec.fromSource

folderName.description: Target folder name in the Data Lake

fileFormat.description: Format of files to be written (e.g., parquet, csv)

title: Runtime configurations for writing to a datalake table from a {@link SourceCollection}.
name: DataInteg.Pipeline.Step.Load.OutputConfiguration.DataLakeConfig
